svg.text: Molecular structure → candidate fragments → intensities → spectrum
Schematic examples · ⋯ / ⋮ indicate omitted set members · A model groups related operations; a head predicts a specific output.
Inputs: atom / bond features + acquisition metadata
Pool shared embeddings for each candidate
Training: two objectives from the same observed spectrum
Normalize marginal weights; match valid channels
Each fragment counted once per observed peak
No spectrum gradient into proposal model
Standard joint training, shared encoder, proposal-selection-only mode · discrete candidate selection · dashed arrows indicate parameter updates
Support loss uses retained, matched candidates only; unmatched peaks contribute zero. Proposal-only warm-up and separate encoders change encoder routing.
